Ours-mip ran WITHOUT the Mip 3D filter: train.log 'Mip 3D filter off (6.46M-17.4M px per training image, threshold 300000)' — the gate counts native source pixels, not the /8 training pixels (~100-270k, which would be under threshold). Registered arm is just '--render-mode mip' on binary eb90dee2, so the run is valid as registered, but any interpretation ('mip loses at x2') must say the 3D filter was gated off by a native-px check; this is plausibly a gate bug.
